title: Qualify a sealed PR prediction, independent readback and scoped cache
description: Create a labelled public scalar change. Freeze a prediction from production declarations with no JVM execution. Bind both original providers, compile on the old API, recover all original argument and return values twice and re-score the same receipts against opposite predicates. Compare a cold, warm and independently empty cache, replace the object at the same path and restore it.
expected: Public entry, normal returns and the independently measured finite disposition agree. A wrong oracle reverses the verdict without new observations. A changed side is rerun, an unchanged side reused, and the watcher refuses stale original bytes.
